title: Chios expedition (1599)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Chios expedition (1599)", at revision 1370611264, opens: "In 1599, the Florentines launched an expedition against the Ottoman-held island of Chios. The expedition ended in disaster for the Florentine forces." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q120848063, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "tuscan campaign in Chios, late 16th century". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
